name: Virtual Battlefield
summary: This is a multiplayer VR game that offers various exciting features and modes, such as the thrilling Boss Mode with epic battles and rewards, and the dynamic Free-for-All Mode for intense combat. Players can explore a diverse arsenal of weapons like bows, pistols, and cards, while enjoying additional features like a Shop System to purchase items and characters, and a Friends System to team up and strategize.
